title: Passport Bass Parade
style: Phonk blues big band with dembow-locked swing, stomping club tempo, and cinematic brass punches; verse rides low with dusty guitar stabs and baritone chants, pre-chorus strips to handclaps and bass growl, chorus hits with mass gang shouts and horn fanfare. Layered call-and-response vocals, delay throws on the chant word, risers into every drop, reversed brass swells between phrases, huge bright-punchy mix with deep sub and glossy brass shine., big band, world, blues
